web_invalid_link: This link doesn't work any more. Scan the QR code on the host's phone again.
web_paused_text: The host is in the menu. The game continues when they're back.
web_waiting_text: The host hasn't started a game yet. This page updates by itself.
web_lobby_text: The host is still setting up the game. It starts here as soon as they start it.
web_pick_hint: Pick your player. This %1$s then plays for them.
web_takeover_confirm: %1$s is already connected on another %2$s. Take over?
web_your_turn: Your turn: tap where this song belongs, then Lock in.
web_your_turn_twice: Your turn: tap where this song belongs, then tap it again to lock in.
web_veto_pick_twice: Tap a free gap, then tap it again for your veto.
web_confirm_twice: Tap a gap twice to confirm
web_veto_pick: Tap a free gap for your veto, then Confirm.
web_veto_placed: Your veto is in. Waiting for the reveal.
web_waiting_vetoes: Waiting for the others to veto or not.
web_p2p_unreachable: Can't reach the host. Check that the link is complete, or ask the host for a new one.
web_outdated: This page is out of date. Reload it to join.
web_requests_stop_hint: Stop ends them for the rest of this game.
web_requests_stopped: Stopped for the rest of this game.
web_host_named_hint_active: +1 veto, even after a wrong placement
web_host_named_hint_vetoers: +1 veto for the active player, a vetoer gets their veto back; even after a wrong placement. Only one player can be marked.
web_host_named_hint_all: +1 veto for whoever named it (a vetoer gets their veto back); even after a wrong placement. Only one player can be marked.
web_host_named_hint_skip: The player who named it gets a skip, even without winning the round. Only one player can be marked.
web_host_adjust_vetoes_hint: Fix mistakes, e.g. a wrongly ticked naming bonus.
web_host_adjust_skips_hint: Fix a mistake, e.g. a wrongly marked name
web_takeover_waiting: Waiting for the host to allow it…
web_blocked: The host removed this %1$s from the game.
web_left: You were removed from the game. You can keep watching.
web_invalid_link_internet: This link doesn't work any more. Ask the host for a new one.
web_confirm_twice_hint: Tapping the chosen gap again locks in or places the veto, without the extra button.
web_vetoes_lost: The vetoes on this song are spent.
web_remove_text: %1$s stops playing. Their score stays on the scoreboard, greyed out.
web_remove_turn: It's their turn: the round ends, and the song leaves the game unless a veto already won it.
